Cargo-Lite 2.0 ships a shared build cache

Cargo-Lite 2.0 was released on Tuesday

The headline feature is a shared build cache keyed by the content hash of each crate

One company reported that clean builds dropped from 41 minutes to 6

The old TOML configuration format is removed in 3.0; a migration command rewrites it

The cache can live on local disk or on any S3-compatible bucket.
